question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to make it a meaningful sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution'.**

One must **__not only have the ability to read voraciously but have__** the necessary training in comprehending and remembering all the relevant details.

options.text: not only have the ability for read voraciously but also have
not only have the ability to read voraciously but also had
not only have the ability to read voraciously but also have

solution:
The correct answer is** "not only have the ability to read voraciously but also have."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
